title.fr: Des marchands qui sentent le marécage

text.es: «Bob Totalmente Humano, vendedor de sombreros muy normales.» Venga ya. Todo mercader honrado lleva el sello real; esos tres no tienen ninguno.
text.en: “Totally Human Bob, seller of very normal hats.” Please. Every honest merchant carries the royal seal; those three have none.
text.fr: « Bob Totalement Humain, vendeur de chapeaux très normaux. » Sans blague. Tout marchand honnête porte le sceau royal ; ces trois-là n’en ont aucun.

text.es: Bórralos del Registro. Y ya que estamos, los guardias del mercado se van al almacén: no pienso perder ni una moneda más.
text.en: Strike them from the Registry. And while you are at it, the market guards move to the storehouse: I will not lose a single coin more.
text.fr: Raye-les du Registre. Et tant qu’on y est, les gardes du marché passent à l’entrepôt : je ne perdrai pas une pièce de plus.

task.es: 1) Borra de `merchants` a todos los mercaderes cuyo `seal` es `'none'`. 2) En `guards`, cambia a `'Storehouse'` el `post` de todos los guardias que ahora están en `'Market'`.
task.en: 1) Delete from `merchants` every merchant whose `seal` is `'none'`. 2) In `guards`, change the `post` to `'Storehouse'` for every guard currently at `'Market'`.
task.fr: 1) Supprime de `merchants` tous les marchands dont le `seal` vaut `'none'`. 2) Dans `guards`, passe à `'Storehouse'` le `post` de tous les gardes actuellement au `'Market'`.

hints.es: `DELETE` borra filas enteras. Como `UPDATE`, sin un `WHERE` afecta a toda la tabla, así que piensa bien la condición.
hints.en: `DELETE` removes whole rows. Like `UPDATE`, without a `WHERE` it hits the entire table, so think carefully about the condition.
hints.fr: `DELETE` supprime des lignes entières. Comme `UPDATE`, sans `WHERE` il touche toute la table : réfléchis bien à la condition.

hints.es: Fíjate en que algunos mercaderes legítimos también traen permiso de la `'Red Treasury'`: lo que delata a los goblins es el sello, no el permiso.
hints.en: Notice that some honest merchants also carry a permit from the `'Red Treasury'`: what gives the goblins away is the seal, not the permit.
hints.fr: Remarque que certains marchands honnêtes ont aussi un permis de la `'Red Treasury'` : ce qui trahit les gobelins, c’est le sceau, pas le permis.

hints.es: Casi lo tienes: `DELETE FROM merchants WHERE seal = 'none'; UPDATE guards SET post = 'Storehouse' WHERE ...;`
hints.en: Almost there: `DELETE FROM merchants WHERE seal = 'none'; UPDATE guards SET post = 'Storehouse' WHERE ...;`
hints.fr: Tu y es presque : `DELETE FROM merchants WHERE seal = 'none'; UPDATE guards SET post = 'Storehouse' WHERE ...;`

text.es: Sir Aldric, mire esto: los tres goblins entraron avalados por Lady Maud. Los tres.
text.en: Sir Aldric, look at this: all three goblins were vouched for by Lady Maud. All three.
text.fr: Sire Aldric, regardez : les trois gobelins ont été recommandés par Dame Maud. Tous les trois.

text.es: Maud… Traían permisos de la Tesorería Roja, y el Reino Rojo es nuestro aliado; quizá eso la convenció. O quizá no. Sigue leyendo, escriba, y no le digas nada a nadie.
text.en: Maud… They carried permits from the Red Treasury, and the Red Kingdom is our ally; perhaps that convinced her. Or perhaps not. Keep reading, scribe, and say nothing to anyone.
text.fr: Maud… Ils avaient des permis de la Trésorerie Rouge, et le Royaume Rouge est notre allié ; c’est peut-être ce qui l’a convaincue. Ou peut-être pas. Continue de lire, scribe, et n’en parle à personne.

setup:
CREATE TABLE merchants (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, goods TEXT NOT NULL, permit_from TEXT NOT NULL, seal TEXT NOT NULL, vouched_by TEXT NOT NULL);
INSERT INTO merchants (name, goods, permit_from, seal, vouched_by) VALUES
  ('Hilda Brightwool', 'wool', 'Blue Castle', 'royal', 'Brother Fen'),
  ('Odo the Salter', 'salt', 'Blue Castle', 'royal', 'Sir Aldric'),
  ('Mira of Redmoor', 'spices', 'Red Treasury', 'royal', 'Lady Maud'),
  ('Totally Human Bob', 'very normal hats', 'Red Treasury', 'none', 'Lady Maud'),
  ('Snik Honestman', 'sheep (slightly used)', 'Red Treasury', 'none', 'Lady Maud'),
  ('Pell the Tinker', 'pots and pans', 'Blue Castle', 'royal', 'Brother Fen'),
  ('Gubbins & Sons', 'barrels (do not shake)', 'Red Treasury', 'none', 'Lady Maud'),
  ('Ysolde', 'silk', 'Red Treasury', 'royal', 'Dame Rowena');
CREATE TABLE guards (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, post TEXT NOT NULL);
INSERT INTO guards (name, post) VALUES
  ('Bertram', 'Market'),
  ('Joss', 'Northwatch'),
  ('Hilde', 'Market'),
  ('Rolf', 'East gate'),
  ('Wilm', 'Market'),
  ('Cedric', 'Castle gate');
solution:
DELETE FROM merchants WHERE seal = 'none';
UPDATE guards SET post = 'Storehouse' WHERE post = 'Market';

accepted: UPDATE guards SET post = 'Storehouse' WHERE post = 'Market'; DELETE FROM merchants WHERE seal <> 'royal';
rejected: DELETE FROM merchants WHERE id IN (4, 5, 7); UPDATE guards SET post = 'Storehouse' WHERE name IN ('Bertram', 'Hilde', 'Wilm');
